title: 9th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/9/1/2026).

Question time: Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal asks the Minister of Economic Development, Transport and Trade, Mohamed Saeed, why restaurant businesses (reserved for Maldivians under the FDI policy) have been opened to Chinese companies without conditions under the China-Maldives Free Trade Agreement, whether industry stakeholders and small businesses were consulted, and whether the FDI policy is being changed to open the sector to the world.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission of the names of 12 persons appointed to the Cabinet on 14 April 2026 under Article 129(a) of the Constitution, seeking the Majlis's consent under Article 129(d), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission of the names of 2 persons appointed to the Cabinet on 15 April 2026 under Article 129(a) of the Constitution, seeking the Majlis's consent under Article 129(d), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Maldives Fisheries Act (Law No. 14/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by South Thinadhoo MP Mohamed Alsan Ahmed.

First reading of a resolution submitted by South Galolhu MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem, to gauge the view of members on Public Service Media (PSM) discriminating between political parties in carrying out its duties, denying the Maldivian Democratic Party the opportunity to inform the public, and failing to ensure the editorial independence required by law.

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the resolution submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim, to gauge the view of members on actions the government is taking contrary to the Constitution, relevant laws and the 2026 state budget passed by the Majlis.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Economic Minister on opening restaurants to Chinese firms, send 14 new cabinet appointments to committee, introduce a Fisheries Act amendment and a PSM resolution, and continue debating a resolution against the government.
